sources.summary: Dezeen Showroom: Cologne-based design studio KaschKasch and brand Villeroy & Boch have released a series of hand-glazed, surface-mounted washbasins. Adding to Villeroy & Boch's existing Antao collection, Antao Earth washbasins are shaped like dewdrops and finished with an Artisan Glaze that is applied by hand.
